w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Chorus Line is here.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Raj freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Raj: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 8× Cattail (960 kcal). You also gather deadfall: 1× branches. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Ines freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Ines: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🪨 Peyton pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (78 stone now.)
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: The Tiny Door. A door appears in the village. It is very small. Someone has to go through. The audience has opinions about who."
📺 SYSTEM: "The System's whim: Peyton is *interesting*."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/14/7), with 4 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 36 → 24 · capped · Craft 11 · Talk 17 · Explore 50 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ines Duarte ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
